title: The Physical Origin of Matter, Energy, Time, and Angular Momentum in World—Universe Cosmology
summary: World—Universe Cosmology (WUC) proposes that the physical World is a finite, boundless three-dimensional Hypersphere forming the surface of an expanding four-dimensional Nucleus embedded in the Eternal Universe. The Nucleus expands in the fourth spatial dimension at the fundamental speed (c). Matter is continuously created by the Eternal Universe through the formation of Universe-Created Particles (UCPs) within the expanding Nucleus.The present paper proposes a common physical foundation for Matter, Energy, Time, and Angular Momentum.
